selection.rule: Parkes only; deterministic all exact S aliases including HIP, GJ etc from published list-targets. Same strict R37B native cadence/headers, target/day/file/URL and 0.1 degree sky exclusions including N1+N2, historical/R40H/R37/R40CDE. Exclude all known original and new raw tile hashes; manifest fixed before power. Stop at 8 eligible groups, if 6-7 use first N-2 fit and last 2 holdout; fewer than 6 report partial metadata only, no relaxed rules.

labels: 128 synthetic injected positives, 128 corresponding unmodified backgrounds and 32 shared-reference stationary leakage injections per day via pinned R40N gather methodology and new fixed seed. Same 4 candidate windows and amplitude/path/gap distribution. No natural-null or real source label claim. Recompute frozen R40G and Joint Min with no path changes; record provenance and truth arrays for development. Holdout spectra/labels not read before candidate lock. No external exam claim.
fit: New same-band fit groups only. Separate authenticated 8-day N3 recurrence bank and 1024 null calibration patches (487/487 parent-rejected strata) unchanged; no own training day in bank. Neighborhood and matched-placebo from N5A, full coverage and nonconstant noncoverage columns required. Fixed raw, central, neighborhood, placebo logistic/tree; group-held-out OOF diagnostic and five prespecified cuts. Also report prior N5A/R40H as historical comparison only; no use of R40H in fit or candidate selection. Freeze all models/cuts before acquiring 2 new holdout days; report all variants, no tuning on holdout.
gate: On new holdout: zero paired Joint Min losses ordinary/shared including weak, no R40G loss, control alert fraction <=35/640 and <=7/8 of frozen Learned05 count if nonzero. Report exact counts and per-day data, wrong paths and coverage. Gate not external validation; 2 days not sufficient for general FAP. No production/adoption/exam start.
